backstop.closure_target: terminal debt/GDP no higher than its 2036Q3 inherited level and no more than a 0.1 percentage-point increase over the final four quarters
backstop.inflation_rate_response: none while the rate cap is imposed
backstop.rate_cap_definition: new bill, note, bond, and TIPS issuance rates return immediately to the CBO baseline path; coupons on inherited debt remain unchanged

experiment: rate-cap and inflation paths after a decade of refinancing stress
interpretation: conditional Treasury-cohort arithmetic; Federal Reserve implementation, investor demand, and behavioral macroeconomic responses remain outside the experiment

pre_backstop.recession: -2% annualized for four quarters, 0% for four, then baseline
